continuity_scope: Terms-only emergent-fiction audit bound to One Seven Design's Blades in the Dark System Reference Document (released December 2017) and the corresponding original standalone core product, Evil Hat EHP0030 (currently listed as a 328-page hardcover). No separate numbered core edition is asserted. The SRD licenses core mechanics but expressly excludes the core setting IP, NPCs, maps, and art; Doskvol is therefore evidenced here only by the official core-product listing, not treated as licensed SRD content.
work_or_witnesses: Blades in the Dark System Reference Document, One Seven Design, December 2017 release
Blades in the Dark, original standalone core product, Evil Hat EHP0030
coverage_rule: This is a rules system and setting without a fixed canonical cast. Include an individual character only if official core material directly profiles that named person as a stable dramatic individual. The official witnesses instead describe players creating characters and a crew as co-authors; named playbooks, crew types, factions, city material, ghosts, and rules are retained only as source terms. No individual satisfies the stated rule.
omissions: Table-created player characters, crews, NPCs, and campaigns, which are emergent rather than a fixed core cast.
Named factions and setting examples not directly profiled as individual dramatic characters in the official witness set.
Actual plays, fan creations, hacks and other Forged in the Dark games, and home campaigns.
Supplements and later material, including Blades in the Dark: Deep Cuts and Blades '68.
Setting-IP details beyond the limited Doskvol term; the official SRD license excludes Duskwall/Shattered Isles, NPCs, maps, and art.
uncertainties: The official product listing does not state a numbered edition or a full errata history. The official core play sheets are marked v3, but this aid is not treated as a global core-edition or errata declaration.
December 2017 is the official SRD release date, not an independently verified first-print date for EHP0030.

The game's crime, violence, occult horror, incarceration, and vice/addiction-adjacent material may require table-specific content discussion; these are not claims about real communities or clinical conditions.
The setting and protagonists are collaboratively created in play, so this terms-only result does not claim to catalogue all possible canonical table outcomes.
evidence_basis: Official One Seven Design SRD pages and licensing notice, plus the official Evil Hat core-product listing. No fan wikis, actual-play material, or unofficial supplements were used as canonical evidence.

citations.locator: System Reference Document Overview; The Game; The Players
supports: The SRD identifies its scope and describes a group of player-created characters and crew co-authored in play.
The SRD was released in December 2017 under CC BY 3.0 and does not grant rights to the core setting, NPCs, maps, or art.
EHP0030 is the official standalone core product, listed as a 328-page hardcover, and frames play in Doskvol with player-selected playbooks and crew types.
